Hi all — quick technical appendix below and I attached a 1-page runbook PDF inline.

Short explanation of KV cache eviction amplification:
- In a multi-tenant hosted path, we maintain per-request KV caches at the serving layer to speed up generation. If one tenant suddenly starts a large prefix-heavy workload, that tenant's growth can cause overall memory pressure. If eviction is coarse-grained (per-process), cache misses for other tenants spike, increasing per-token compute as the model must re-compute keys — this drives more GPU cycles and higher latency cluster-wide.

Mitigation by deployment mode:
- Hosted API: automatic request shaping + fair-share batching limits; prefix-KV sharding and per-tenant soft-limits. We also have dynamic fallback to smaller model variants when latency SLOs are threatened; however, Hosted is subject to transient noisy-neighbor effects during simultaneous bursts.
- Dedicated capacity: isolated GPU pools per customer; you get predictable throughput and strict KV cache residency so cross-tenant eviction is not a risk. SLA-backed latency with committed capacity.
- Private (VPC/on-prem): full isolation, customer-managed infra — eliminates cross-tenant interference but adds ops overhead and longer lead time for scaling.

Runbook excerpt (attached as short-runbook-noisy-neighbor.pdf):
1) Detect: P95 latency > threshold for >2 minutes and token compute per-second trending +30%.
2) Protect: Apply per-tenant throttles at edge and switch to pre-warmed smaller variant for affected tenant.
3) Recover: Autoscale dedicated pool (if Dedicated) or shift load regionally (if Hosted multi-region) and notify customer with an incident timeline.

I'll convert the above to a short visual matrix mapping your three workload profiles to recommendations and include cost buckets. Sending draft by Friday EOD.

Quick notes on the cost buckets (order-of-magnitude):
- Hosted API: lowest up-front (pay-as-you-go), estimated steady-state avg cost for 50 TPS with your model mix ~ $26k/month. Peaks handled elastically; P95 latency best-effort with built-in fallbacks.
- Dedicated capacity (reserved pool): predictable, SLA-backed. For equivalent headroom to cover 200 TPS peaks we'd estimate committed monthly cost in the ~$90k–120k/month range depending on GPU class and reserved instance size.
- Private (VPC/on-prem): highest initial ops & infra cost; ongoing support + license + infra could put you north of $150k/month total cost of ownership for fully private with ops.
